meta.dataset: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients (Yeh & Lien 2009), Taiwan, 2005

features.label: Credit limit
features.help: Credit line on the card in New Taiwan dollars.

features.label: Most recent repayment status
features.help: Months past due on the latest statement. 0 means not late.

features.label: Worst repayment status in 6 months
features.help: Largest number of months past due in any of the last six statements.

features.label: Months delinquent in 6 months
features.help: How many of the last six months the account was at least one month past due.

features.label: Months since last delinquency
features.help: 0 means late this month. 6 means no late payment in the six-month window.

features.label: Current utilisation
features.help: Latest statement balance divided by the credit limit. Capped at 1.5.

features.label: Average utilisation over 6 months
features.help: Average statement balance over six months divided by the credit limit.

features.label: Utilisation trend
features.help: Average utilisation in the latest three months minus the three months before. Positive means balances are rising.

features.label: Share of billed amount repaid
features.help: Payments in the last five months divided by the statements they were due on. 1 means everything billed was repaid.

features.label: Last payment amount
features.help: Amount paid in the most recent month in New Taiwan dollars.

features.label: Months paid in full
features.help: How many of the last six statements were paid in full.

features.label: Months with no balance
features.help: How many of the last six statements showed no balance (card not in use).

assumptions.exposure: most recent statement balance, floored at zero
assumptions.note: Illustrative only. lgd and annual_margin are assumptions, not estimates from the data. Index 100 is the best cutoff on the test-set grid; the recommended cutoff was chosen on the validation set.

reasons.worst_status_6m: Worst delinquency in the last six months was too severe
reasons.months_late_6m: Too many late payments in the last six months
reasons.months_since_late: Last late payment was too recent
reasons.util_current: Current balance is high relative to the credit limit
reasons.util_avg_6m: Average balance over six months is high relative to the credit limit
reasons.util_trend: Balances have been rising relative to the credit limit
reasons.pay_ratio: Payments cover too small a share of the amounts billed
reasons.last_payment: Most recent payment amount was low
reasons.months_paid_full: Balance is rarely paid in full
reasons.months_zero_balance: Little or no card use in recent months

presets.name: Among the safest 5% of accounts
presets.note: Limit NT$270,000; no late payment in six months; utilisation 0%; repaid 100% of the amounts billed.

presets.name: Typical approved account
presets.note: Limit NT$150,000; no late payment in six months; utilisation 4%; repaid 100% of the amounts billed.

presets.name: Close to the cutoff
presets.note: Limit NT$350,000; 1 month(s) past due now, late in 1 of the last six months; utilisation 10%; repaid 100% of the amounts billed.

presets.name: Two months past due
presets.note: Limit NT$70,000; 2 month(s) past due now, late in 1 of the last six months; utilisation 103%; repaid 4% of the amounts billed.

presets.name: Behind for most of six months
presets.note: Limit NT$70,000; 2 month(s) past due now, late in 6 of the last six months; utilisation 81%; repaid 4% of the amounts billed.
